name: SparklineCell
description:
The shared Sparkline at row size plus its current value, right-aligned in tabular
figures. The line's accessible name summarises it: now, low and high.
signature: ({ values, domain, tone, label, unit, value, }: SparklineCellProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: domain
props.description: Fixed value range ([0, 100] for percentages). Defaults to the data's range.

props.name: label
props.description: What the series is, e.g. "CPU over the last 20 minutes".

props.name: tone
props.description:
Line colour. Neutral by default so a column of trends reads as texture; use a status
tone only while the value is in that state (R3.3), so problems stand out.

props.name: value
props.description: The value printed beside the line (defaults to the last point).

props.name: values
props.description: Values rendered by the chart or multi-value control.
